name: Chandrima Mercantiles Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1982, Chandrima 
Mercantiles Ltd trades in agricultural 
products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
CML previously dealt with building materials, yarn, jute, jewelry, and ornaments. It also traded cloth, textiles, gold, silver, jewelry, bullion, and related products. Currently, the company focuses on trading agricultural products.

cons: Stock is trading at 4.54 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Working capital days have increased from 98.6 days to 416 days
